Subject: Exec sponsor pairing & EB meeting scheduling — MAP and close timeline

Alex / Nina — following up from our call. Attaching a working MAP (MAP_DRAFT_v3.xlsx) and an initial sponsor roster for your review. Two asks to keep timelines tight for a mid-June close: \n- Confirm primary exec sponsor and one secondary (falls back) for the EB session.\n- Pick 2 preferred 90-minute EB windows (we’ll reserve the boardroom once we lock attendees).\n
Proposed sponsor mapping (internal recommendation):\n- CEO-level champion: Sarah Lin (Rubicon) → target for EB invite\n- CTO-level technical reviewer: Nina Patel (Rubicon)\n
If you can CF earliest availability by Tuesday EOD, we’ll finalize the MAP and send calendar invites. I’ve CC’d Marissa and Priyom to help coordinate the EB logistics and the mutual-action milestones.\n
Attachments: MAP_DRAFT_v3.xlsx (attachment/xlsx)\n
Thanks,\nDiego Fernandez
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Diego Fernandez | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@rubicon.ai>

Date: 2026-05-09T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec sponsor pairing & EB meeting scheduling — MAP and close timeline

Diego — thanks for the note and the draft MAP. Quick answers from our side: \n- Primary exec sponsor: Vanessa Cortez, CFO (will lead EB session).\n- Secondary exec sponsor: Marcus Osei, Head of Infrastructure (backup).\n
EB availability (our preference):\n1) Week of June 8 — Tuesday or Wednesday morning PT (90 min)\n2) Week of June 15 — Thursday afternoon PT (90 min)\n
I attached our sponsor export (ExecSponsor_Roster_Rubicon.csv) — includes titles and preferred calendar domains so you can route invites correctly. Procurement is looped for contract timeline alignment.\n
On timelines: procurement needs a final SOW by June 1 to stay on the June close path. That means we should lock the executive attendee list and MAP milestones by May 14.\n
Thanks — I’ll confirm Vanessa’s windows after I sync with her calendar.\nAlex Turner
Director, Strategic Accounts | Rubicon Analytics

On Sun, May 9, 2026 at 10:45 AM Alex Turner <alex.turner@rubicon.ai> wrote:
> Diego — thanks for the note and the draft MAP. Quick answers from our side: ...

Internal coordination — brief plan and owners: \n- Action: Finalize MAP milestones and deliverables by 2026-05-14 (owner: Priyom).\n- Action: Draft EB agenda (90 min) — objectives, technical deep dive, procurement ask, decision checkpoint (owner: Marissa).\n- Action: Send preliminary invites once Vanessa confirms two preferred slots (owner: Diego).\n
Proposed EB agenda (high level):\n1) 0-10m: Exec intro & business value highlights (Vanessa + Sarah)\n2) 10-40m: Product demo — focused on integration + cost SLOs (Redwood engineering + Marcus Osei)\n3) 40-70m: Q&A / procurement + security clarifications (SOC2 Q&A doc attached)\n4) 70-90m: Decision and next steps (DocuSign link for SOW)\n
I updated the MAP with milestones tied to procurement dates and uploaded MAP_DRAFT_v3.xlsx (v3 -> v4 candidate) to the shared Drive link. Priyom — can you align the milestone owners and confirm who on our side will be on the EB tech panel?\n
Diego

Marissa — quick confirmations: I will own the EB agenda doc and coordinate the panelists. Priyom, Diego — please confirm engineering panel: I recommend Rishi on latency/costs and Laura B. to cover compliance questions.\n

Alex / Nina / Procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal alignment, attaching the finalized MAP (MAP_DRAFT_v3.xlsx -> MAP_v4_final) and SOC2 excerpt.\n
Final notes and asks: \n- Vanessa (Rubicon CFO) confirmed availability: June 9, 09:00–10:30 PT or June 16, 13:30–15:00 PT. Please confirm preferred slot by May 14 so procurement can meet the SOW deadline.\n- We will send the 90-minute invite with the agenda Marissa will publish (owner: Marissa).\n- Procurement: we will deliver a redlined SOW preview by May 20; doc will be uploaded to the DocuSign room (link above).\n
Attachments: MAP_v4_final.xlsx, SOC2_Q_and_A.pdf, ExecSponsor_Roster_Rubicon.csv (reference)\n
Next step: Alex — once you confirm the slot, I’ll issue calendar invites and trigger the DocuSign room for signatures.\n
Best,\nDiego Fernandez
